The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), the government's socioeconomic planning agency, revised the target forSecondary Participation Rate in mid 2011 for inclusion in the Philippine Development Plan (PDP) for 2011-2016. The revised PDPtarget for this indicator for 2011 is 65.16%.

The secondary participation rate of 64.84% for 2011 was computed using the 2010 census data recently released by the NationalStatistics Office. The Inter-Agency Committee on Education Statistics is currently reviewing this prior to granting officialconfirmation.

The Department of Education is using the completion rate formula for efficiency. If the completion rate formula for access isused(as used by UIS and WDI), the completion rate at the elementary level for 2011 is at 92.82%
